messages:
anya: PR up with two short provisioning patterns for dedicated capacity: reserved-pool and burst-pool. link: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4621. need quick review for naming and SLA blurb.

sam: i'll review today. prefer `target_utilization_pct` over `threshold_pct`. also want a 1-line CLI example for tenant admins.

marta: agree on naming. add eviction note for burst pools: preemptible under high cluster pressure (link to eviction-model).

kevin: SDK snippet ready: `client.provision_capacity(tenant="team-echo", pool_type="burst", policy={"target_utilization_pct":70, "cooldown_seconds":300})`. will paste in PR.

anya: perfect. sam, can you add CLI: `redwoodctl capacity set-policy --tenant team-echo --type burst --target 70 --cooldown 300` and a 2-line SLA tradeoffs note?

sam: added CLI + tiny smoke test in branch. SLA note: reserved pools = latency SLA; burst = cost-efficient but preemptible, no latency SLA.

docs-bot: Reminder: keep examples short, use present tense, link params. :memo:

anya: thanks all. merge once CI passes and @kevin confirms SDK formatting.
